headline: Analyst Jigar Patel picks Omnitech Engineering, IT BEES, and Laxmi Organic for short term
hook: Three technical picks for the week
summary: Analyst Jigar Patel has recommended technical buy positions on Omnitech Engineering, IT BEES, and Laxmi Organic Industries. His analysis indicates potential trend reversals on these counters, making them short-term trade candidates. Retail investors tracking momentum strategies can review their technical setups and defined stop losses before entry.
why_it_matters: Short-term trading ideas offer tactical entry points for active retail investors.
